# units/min

> n min: minutes: 60 sec, as nanoseconds.

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/min.pkg)

```
print 5 min    // 300000000000
```

Binds tighter than any operator, so `2 * 3 min` is `2 * (3 min)`.
See [units](../units.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{n: expr int} min -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `n` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
